description: The reconstruction's own parse is not a query. c asks whether its original span, the whole input A, parses as text. That query parses A with the main grammar and completes through a and b, which ask nothing, and c cannot complete over A. So no query asks about its own span, and c is a second reading (engine §4, §7.6).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T]
%rule b A [+T] [+U]
%rule c A T
%conditions matches($, text)
